text:
For 2026-Q1, the structured quality reporting records include two measures: READM-30, “30-day all-cause readmission rate,” and SEP-B1, “Sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours.” This narrative reports only the values contained in the source records and uses the measure definitions as named in those records.

For READM-30, the reported unit is percent. The numerator is 188, the denominator is 1325, and exclusions are 43. The reported rate is 14.66 percent. The event dates listed in the source record are 2026-01-24, 2026-04-18, 2026-06-19, 2026-07-17, and 2026-11-21. This measure is associated with readmission reporting, with related reference context available for readmission prediction [F49].

For SEP-B1, the reported unit is percent. The numerator is 115, the denominator is 535, and exclusions are 41. The reported rate is 23.28 percent. The event dates listed in the source record are 2026-02-14, 2026-04-08, 2026-08-18, 2026-09-28, and 2026-10-19. The measure name specifies sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours.

Across the two 2026-Q1 source records, both measures are expressed as percentages and include numerator, denominator, exclusion count, reported rate, and event date fields. The records do not provide additional stratification, facility identifiers, patient-level characteristics, or benchmark values. Available reference context also includes quality measure automation [F31] and infection control dashboards [F20].
